name: Snap Inc.
blurb: Snap Inc. operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app, and offers advertising products, subscription services (Snapchat+, Lens+, Snapchat Platinum), and augmented reality glasses (Spectacles). The company generates revenue primarily from advertising and faces competition from other social media platforms. As of May 2026, Snap has a market cap of about $10.3 billion and is unprofitable, with a net loss of $460 million on revenue of $5.93 billion.
recent: In late April 2026, Snap announced a deal with Experian to integrate AI-powered financial education tools into Snapchat's AI Sponsored Snaps format, and disclosed an upcoming CFO transition. The stock rose 11.3% following the news, but also faced an activist investor letter pressing for a review of its Spectacles subsidiary and governance issues. As of May 6, 2026, SNAP traded at $6.11, down 9.47% after-hours.

sources.title: Snap (SNAP) Is Up 11.3% After Experian AI Ads Deal And Activist Letter
